title: ToyVentor pre-print validation report
description: One report per STL, written by preprint_check.py. The app reads verdict, summary and print_settings; metrics and slicer feed pricing and print queues.

part_id.description: Catalog id, or the file stem for an uploaded or generated STL.

verdict.description: pass: print as is. pass_with_settings: print with print_settings applied. pass_with_warnings: printable, but show the warnings. fail: do not print or sell.

id.description: V* checks are geometry (always run); S* checks come from the slicer.

slenderness.description: Height divided by the square root of the bed contact area.

thin_wall_regions.description: Connected regions thinner than min_wall_mm with min thickness and 3D coordinates.

ledges.description: Flat undersides held on one side only: z, area and a point near the worst one.

floating_contours.description: Unanchored hole loops in bridge ceilings or low-Z hovering cantilevers caught by V11.

print_settings.description: Per-part settings the print must use, e.g. a brim. Empty when the profile's defaults are enough.

slicer.description: Null when no slicer was available (geometry checks only).

filament_cost_usd.description: Filament only, at the profile's price per kg. Not a print price.

slice_logic.description: Version of the slicing stage; a cached slice is reused while it, the file fingerprint and the profile match.

reused_from.description: When this slice was reused from an earlier report, that report's check time.
